pass_gates.rule: Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM 1m covers about 99 percent of England
Environment Agency composite DTM spatial resolution is 1 metre
DTM uses the last or only laser pulse returned to the sensor
Surface objects are removed to produce terrain-only elevation
Composite combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys
Where surveys repeat the newest best-resolution data is selected
Resampled source data uses bilinear interpolation before merge
Composite DTM is delivered as GeoTIFF rasters in 5km tiles aligned to the OS National Grid
Elevation units are metres
Vertical reference is Ordnance Survey Newlyn
Composite uses OSTN15 transformation
Input LIDAR surveys report plus or minus 15cm RMSE vertical accuracy
